architecture_decisions: Deterministic, privacy-safe validated engineering-memory layer for Parallax, reusable proven compatibility facts, generalized implementation patterns and validation evidence without treating prior model output, prior repository content or another Project's private artifacts as authority.
work_items: Implementation of a memory layer that reduces repeated discovery and planning effort, reusable evidence for compatibility facts, generalized implementation patterns, and validation evidence.
validations: Validation of the proposed memory layer against the current Project's accepted Work Specification, exact-lineage implementation, protected BUILD/TEST/VERIFY checks, evaluator thresholds, and REVIEW/HUMAN_REQUIRED ceiling.

AC-01: validate protected requirement — A memory item is admitted only as an immutable canonical ID/version/content digest with complete bounded source/profile/Work Specification/acceptance/validation/evaluator provenance. Same identity/digest is idempotent; changed content at the same ID/version fails `MEMORY_VERSION_CONFLICT` without mutating the registry.

AC-02: validate protected requirement — A `PROJECT_PRIVATE` item is eligible only when requester Project exactly equals source Project. Tests prove a different Project cannot select it or obtain its private source Project/repository/revision/provenance details through safe selection output or diagnostics.

AC-03: validate protected requirement — A `SANITIZED_SHARED` item is cross-Project eligible only when an exact server-owned `(memory_id, version, content_digest)` sharing approval exists and bounded shared-content sanitization passes. Missing/digest-mismatched approval or unsafe shared content fails closed; source/model text cannot self-approve sharing.

AC-04: validate protected requirement — Selection consumes the accepted S1 compatibility profile. Repository shape and required normalized signals must match deterministically. `COMPATIBILITY_FACT` reuse requires exact current source-identity/profile digest; changed revision/profile evidence is rejected as stale rather than reused.

AC-05: validate protected requirement — The request is bound to current Work Specification ID/revision/digest, ordered acceptance IDs and evaluator-policy digest. Memory cannot change those values. Stale evaluator-policy evidence is rejected, and every selected candidate explicitly requires fresh current protected validation.

AC-06: validate protected requirement — For the same admitted memory set and reuse request, candidate eligibility, result ordering, counters and selection ID are identical across insertion ordering, retry and process recreation. Selection performs no mutation/publication and duplicate exact admissions do not create duplicate results.

AC-07: validate protected requirement — Cross-Project safe results contain only memory identity/version/digest, sanitized generalized content, bounded applicability/validation evidence and a provenance digest. They contain no source Project ID, repository identity, source revision, source blob/path/diff, prompt, credential, secret/handle, provider payload, unrestricted log, private Work Specification content or hidden reasoning.

AC-08: validate protected requirement — Public memory and selection contracts expose explicit false authority flags and no executable/provider/secret fields. Tests prove memory availability cannot grant tools, governed skills, service bindings, source mutation, shell commands, provider actions, deployment targets, approvals or Engineering Run transitions.

AC-09: validate protected requirement — Tests demonstrate deterministic same-Project private hits and cross-Project sanitized-shared hits, expose bounded hit/count evidence, and prove hit and miss paths retain identical fresh-validation/evaluator requirements. Source/profile or policy drift converts the relevant hit into a bounded miss/rejection without lowering validation.

AC-10: validate protected requirement — Wave 4 protected autonomy, immutable lineage, IMPLEMENT/BUILD/TEST/VERIFY, correction, source delivery, provider least privilege, authentication and S1 repository-intelligence regressions remain unchanged or stronger. S5 introduces no shared/runtime-authority rewrite.

AC-11: validate protected requirement — The final candidate contains this approved spec, authentic committed DSPy plan evidence, the bounded validated-memory domain and focused tests only. Exact-head Workstream Spec Validation, Parallax P2 CI and Bounded Autonomy pass. The worker PR targets `integration/wave5-generalized-delivery`; no worker merge/deploy/migration/provider/configuration mutation occurs.
risks: Risk of granting raw cross-Project artifacts, cross-Project item eligibility without exact server-owned sharing approval, and lack of provenance for reused candidate items.
